articles.title: Yemen Al-Khair Relief & Development Foundation (YARD)
articles.description: Yemen Al-Khair Foundation for Relief and Development is a national humanitarian and development organization committed to supporting vulnerable populations affected by conflict, displacement, natural hazards, and socio-economic challenges across Yemen.

articles.title: Harmful information in disasters: Risk communication for safer decisions (Guidance note)
articles.description: This guidance note outlines practical approaches to strengthening information integrity within risk communication–before, during, and after disasters. Preparing for and managing information risks is an integral part of disaster risk reduction efforts.

articles.title: Earth Sciences New Zealand
articles.description: Earth Sciences New Zealand underpins national economic growth through work that enables increased returns from New Zealand’s natural resources and builds resilience to natural hazards and environmental change.

articles.title: UNDRR August 2026 newsletter
articles.description: This month from UNDRR: statements from SRSG Kamal Kishore on the Nepal-Tibet disaster, the Colombia earthquake and the impacts of El Niño; the Early Warnings for All Forum in Ethiopia; the IDRLF 2026 in the Republic of Korea; and more inside.

articles.title: Disaster risk reduction takes center stage in talks on global disaster treaty
articles.description: As UN Member States prepare for negotiations on a proposed international convention on the Protection of Persons in the Event of Disasters (PPED), the need for disaster prevention is emerging as a significant part of the discussion.

articles.title: Africa’s early warning experts and officials call for sustained momentum on life-saving disaster protection systems
articles.description: The Africa Early Warnings Forum, held in Addis Ababa, highlighted Africa's progress in expanding early warning systems, but with climate and disaster risks accelerating, the task now is to translate that progress into protection for everyone.

articles.title: Japan to Host Asia-Pacific Ministerial Conference on Disaster Risk Reduction in Sendai City in 2027
articles.description: The Government of Japan, in partnership with the United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR), will host the 2027 Asia-Pacific Ministerial Conference on Disaster Risk Reduction from 25 to 29 October 2027 in Sendai City, Japan.
